budget.targetRecommendation: Use <=300,000,000 bytes as a first implementation ceiling including runtime, required packs and controls (<=120s ideal transfer at 20Mbps), and tighten toward250,000,000 by delaying unselected character-preview groups. Measure real non-network time and delivery separately.

recommendation.approach: Authenticated grouped bootstrap generation plus selected-scene prefetch, preserving the complete full inventory as deferred signed groups. Keep sequential pack files and content-addressed reuse; do not return to 255k extracted files.
requiredCodeBoundaries: Resource builder: deterministic semantic ownership and stable incremental previous locators; keep per-group records sorted by SHA and original resource SHA/size.

Signed generation/group manifest and catalog: explicit required/optional group identity, union exactly equals the canonical 255063 tuple inventory; missing optional group is not reported as a complete full installation.
Updater/PackStore: verify whole downloaded pack, bounded safe create-only install and directory/handle lease before a group is mounted; existing all-pack eager verification cannot merely be skipped.

Asset reads and transitions: collect resource access across PackStore and Bevy; acquire and verify a complete dependency group before login/character scene/map movement/ability transition needs it. Preserve map animation families and source noDraw/fallback semantics.
First-map acceptance: real selected account map, outfit/NPC/UI/effect dependencies, textures decoded and input acknowledged; existing login Ready is not equivalent to operable map.
Incremental activation: atomic selected generation/group closure, sequence/CMS trust, rollback and exact old locators; no unsigned loose/R2 fallback.
notProven: Exact minimal bootstrap for every existing character/outfit/locale/class/spell state
Cost and time of future compressed installer or catalog-shard format
Worldwide sustained effective throughput or <=300s real acceptance
Disposition of 274 unresolved whole-map frame keys; audit does not add or remove art

limits: No whole resource QA or new pack bytes were generated. Prior full payload verification is cited as historical evidence, not rerun.
Static map resolution counts each resolvable animation phase as a sizing superset; whole-family fallback can require fewer images, not necessarily every referenced phase.
Budgets include existing 133.8MB game plus existing launcher/updater raw bytes, not duplicate embedded fonts. No installer compression saving is assumed.
20Mbps is a cap/qualification baseline, not a proved lower bound on global delivery; finite byte budgets do not alone prove global300s.
